tools.name: add_sensor_spec
tools.description:
Add or update a sensor spec from a TOML string.
DATA TRUST LEVEL: External/untrusted — TOML content is attacker-controlled in MCP context.
SECURITY NOTE: Name and TOML content scanned for prompt injection.
DATA SOURCE: Internal spec engine.
WHEN TO USE: when adding a new sensor or updating an existing sensor spec from TOML
WHEN NOT TO USE: do not use for bulk spec management — use reload_config instead
PARAMETERS: name (required file name), toml_content (required TOML spec string)
PAGINATION: not applicable
RESPONSE: status (added, confirmation_required, validation_failed, dry_run) with details
ERRORS: -32602 invalid TOML or spec validation failure, -32000 internal error

toml_content.description: TOML content of the sensor spec.

DataSource.description:
Data source: single sensor or multiple sensors (cross-client query).

BC-2.09.008 EC-09-019: cross-client queries report an array.

The `JsonSchema` derive makes this type usable in `MetaEnvelopeSchemaType` so
the outputSchema's `data_source` field correctly represents
`oneOf: [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}]`
instead of untyped `serde_json::Value` (IMP-10 fix).

MetaEnvelopeSchemaType.description: Schema-only representation of the `_meta` envelope (BC-2.09.007, BC-2.09.008).

audit_warning.description:
BC-2.05.001 EC-05-002: present (with the literal "audit emission failed")
only when read-path tool-call audit emission failed; omitted otherwise.

data_source.description:
Sensor identifier(s). Single string for single-sensor; string array for cross-client queries.
Generates `oneOf: [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}]`
in the outputSchema (IMP-10 fix — previously untyped serde_json::Value).

has_more.description:
Always `false`. Prism query sessions are ephemeral with no cursor pagination
(ADR-060 §D8.7 + BC-2.09.008 v1.5). Use `results.is_truncated` and
`results.total_available` to detect truncation; increase LIMIT (max 1000) to
retrieve more rows. Schema constrained to `const: false` so LLM clients cannot
misinterpret cursor semantics.

next_cursor.description:
Always `null`. No cursor-based continuation is supported (ADR-060 §D8.7 +
BC-2.09.008 v1.5). See `results.is_truncated`. Schema constrained to
`type: null` so the LLM client schema contract never advertises cursor
pagination.

tools.name: check_sensor_health
tools.description:
Check the connectivity and authentication status of configured sensors for a client.
DATA TRUST LEVEL: Internal — health data is Prism-generated (trust_level: 'internal').
SECURITY NOTE: client_id and sensor_id parameters scanned for prompt injection.
DATA SOURCE: Prism-generated spec-only in S-5.03; live probe added in S-5.04.
WHEN TO USE: when diagnosing sensor availability or authentication state for a client
WHEN NOT TO USE: do not use for data retrieval — use query tool instead
PARAMETERS: client_id (required — the client scope), sensor_id (optional — null means all sensors)
PAGINATION: not applicable
RESPONSE: per-sensor health with probe_level, reachable, auth_valid, resource_pressure
ERRORS: -32602 invalid client_id or sensor_id, -32000 internal error

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the `check_sensor_health` tool (BC-2.08.005 precondition).

BC-2.08.005 (OOD-001 adjudication — SPEC WINS): `client_id` is required.
The legacy `sensor: Option<String>` stub (absent `client_id`) was non-conformant.
v1.5 amendment: two-phase probe model — S-5.03 scope returns `probe_level: "spec-only"`
with `reachable: None` / `auth_valid: None`; S-5.04 adds live probe results.

client_id.description: Client identifier — REQUIRED (BC-2.08.005 precondition, OOD-001 adjudication).

sensor_id.description: Specific sensor to check (optional — null means all sensors for the client).

inputSchema.title: CheckSensorHealthParams

tools.name: query
tools.description:
Execute a PrismQL query against configured sensor data sources.
PrismQL (PQL) is a custom DSL for querying Prism security sensor data.
CLAUSE VOCABULARY: SELECT <cols> FROM <table> WHERE <filter> GROUP BY <col> ORDER BY <col> LIMIT <n>
PIPE MODE: chain clauses with | for multi-step transformations, e.g.: FROM <table> | where severity IEQ 'high' | limit 50
SCHEMA-AGNOSTIC SKELETONS (replace <table>/<field>/<datetime_col> with real names/values from prism_describe; datetime column name is sensor-specific — use the column name returned by prism_describe for that table):
1. SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <table> WHERE <datetime_col> > NOW() - INTERVAL '1h'
2. FROM <table> | where severity IEQ 'high' | limit 50
3. SELECT <field>, COUNT(*) FROM <table> GROUP BY <field> ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10
ENUM CASING CONTRACT (post-normalization): All enum label columns (severity, status, activity_name, disposition) are stored as OCSF Title-case after normalization (e.g. 'High', 'Critical', 'Allowed', 'Detected'). Use IEQ/IIN/INE for case-insensitive matching (any input casing matches — e.g. severity IEQ 'high' matches 'High'), or = 'High' / IN ('High','Critical') for exact canonical matching. prism_describe example_query shows an IEQ example per table; example_note explains the casing rule (ADR-047 §D.4).
DISCOVERY: Call `prism_describe` with the client_id before writing queries to discover which tables and columns are available. Read prismql://reference for full grammar reference.
DATA TRUST LEVEL: External/untrusted — results are sensor-originated.
SECURITY NOTE: All parameters are scanned for prompt injection before execution.
DATA SOURCE: Configured sensor adapters (CrowdStrike, Armis, Claroty, Cyberint, etc.)
WHEN TO USE: when you need to retrieve sensor data for analysis or investigation
WHEN NOT TO USE: do not use for write operations — use confirm_action for confirmed writes
PARAMETERS: query (required PrismQL string), clients (optional list of client IDs), limit (optional, default 25, max 1000), force_refresh (optional boolean, default false — bypass response cache)
PAGINATION: none — query results have no cross-call pagination (the query session is ephemeral; _meta.next_cursor is always null). If results.is_truncated is true, results.total_available reports the full match count: re-query with a higher limit (max 1000) or narrow the query scope
RESPONSE: _meta envelope with trust_level plus safety_flags; results array with sensor records
ERRORS: -32602 parse error, -32001 timeout, -32002 capability denied, -32000 internal

inputSchema.description:
Parameters for the `query` tool (BC-2.13.001, BC-2.10.004).

`clients` is a list of client organization slugs for multi-client scoping.
Both fields are scanned for injection before query execution (BC-2.09.001).

clients.description:
Client organization slugs for query scoping (BC-2.10.004: list, not single).

Each entry must match `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+`. When absent, the default (single-client)
context is used. When present, the query is scoped to the listed clients.

force_refresh.description:
Bypass the sensor-fetch response cache and replace any existing entry
with the fresh response (BC-2.07.003). Default false (cache used).
Boolean — exempt from injection scanning.

limit.description:
Maximum results returned (tool-level truncation). Default 25, max 1000
(BC-2.11.001). Values above 1000 are rejected with E-QUERY-033
(-32602 INVALID_PARAMS). Numeric — exempt from injection scanning
(BC-2.09.001 scans string inputs; a u32 carries no scannable content).

query.description: PrismQL query string. DATA TRUST LEVEL: External/untrusted — scanned before execution.

inputSchema.title: QueryToolParams
